methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Transportation (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 3 same-sector peers exist in Transportation, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Pivotal is a Growth-stage transportation company founded by Marcus Leng with approximately $47M in total capital raised. The sector contains three identifiable private peers (Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride) but no public comparables; however, none of these peers satisfy narrow same-stage or adjacent-stage filtering criteria, limiting the applicability of peer-median methods.

Valuation analysis relies on a single applicable method: stage-progression. Using total capital raised ($47M) as a proxy baseline, a standard 1.2x step-up multiplier applied to Growth-stage advancement yields $56M. This reflects typical post-funding valuation expansion at this developmental stage.

The triangulated range spans $48M (low) to $64M (high), with a median of $56M supported by the stage-progression framework. Key uncertainties include the absence of viable same-stage transportation comparables for calibration, reliance on a single methodological input, and incomplete visibility into Pivotal's unit economics or market traction relative to the three identified sector peers. Further valuation refinement would require either additional same-stage Transportation comps or company-specific metrics (revenue run-rate, customer concentration, burn profile) to validate stage-appropriate multiples.
